verdict.note: Accept all. The measurable certified-selector condition is retained only as an explicit implementation-side hypothesis; no measurable selector is claimed constructed. The feasible upper bound is conditional on legality, boundedness, this independently verified measurability, and the separately assumed joint-TV approximation. The lower bound uses only the h-independent reverse-deficiency kernel. The rational unbalanced no-index witness remains unresolved: the solve receipt produced no admissible candidate, exact equalizer closure, tail certificate, or curvature receipt, and the tested rational candidate fails because b(π)≤1/3<3/7≤v.
